segments.motivation: To organize personal tasks and daily to-dos to stay on top of their work.
To coordinate team projects, simplify workflows, and ensure team organization and efficiency.
To visually manage project timelines, tasks, and resources, and integrate with other project tools.

tasks.context: by organizing them on boards and cards
tasks.purpose: to keep track of all responsibilities

tasks.context: by adding due dates and marking cards as 'Done'
tasks.purpose: to monitor deadlines and completion status

tasks.purpose: to keep all relevant resources in one place

tasks.context: by setting up rules for moving tasks or running commands
tasks.purpose: to streamline processes and improve efficiency

benefits.claim: All important information and tasks are kept organized and accessible in one place.
Workflows are simplified and task management is effortless, allowing users to focus on core work.
Clear visual cues and reminders for due dates make it easy to monitor progress and avoid missed deadlines.

frictions.claim: While tasks are tracked, generating complex or detailed project reports might be less intuitive or robust compared to other tools.
AI features, while present, might be perceived as less comprehensive or deeply integrated into workflows compared to competitor offerings.
The board-and-card model, while simple for many uses, may become less effective for managing very large, complex projects with intricate dependencies.

unknowns: Specific pricing tiers mentioned by reviewers
